reason: The submitted Amm2 model is sufficiently established despite the unavailable comparable-score report. The C-centered orthorhombic cell indexes all extracted lines, gives a sensible Z = 2 and density (9.48 g/cm^3), and an unconstrained four-atom motif search repeatedly collapsed onto the submitted Amm2 special positions. Direct whole-profile verification gives Rwp about 4.23% and RMS about 0.195 intensity units, essentially the pattern's noise floor, so the coordinates and element-specific intensities are supported rather than only the cell or average framework. Independently relaxing the most concerning B/Cr site-ordering alternative did not improve the raw-profile fit and produced an implausible approximately 1.13 angstrom Cr-B contact; the submitted structure instead has chemically credible contacts (shortest Ga-B about 2.04 angstrom) and full occupancies. No materially different, physically plausible candidate remains likely to improve the set.
